result:
result: Findings below. No blocker. I read all 105 captures and the tui-design skill and judged them against its checklist. The two material items are the truncated result screen and the unexplained ASCII-locale pty capture. Review-screen truncation at 40x20 is a third, smaller one. Everything else on the stated style and rows passes.

**observations**
Rows are correct. Pi is "fixed" with `[x]`. Device access disappears under `no-device-host`. Both toggles start on. Space on the Pi row is ignored (`pi-fixed-space-ignored`). j/k and focus wrap work (`focus-wrap-j-k`).
Tokens match the brief (title bold #7aa2f7, hint #7dcfff, focus bold #7dcfff, enabled #9ece6a, hint text #737aa2). Headings are uppercase and the title reads "HolyAgent  ·  setup".
NO_COLOR keeps bold only, and the markers and words (`[ ] disabled`, `fixed`, `+ - = ~ !`) carry state without colour.
ASCII locale uses `>`, `-`, `up/down` and `...` throughout (`ascii-locale*`).
Resize reflows both screens (`resize-to-narrow*`, `resize-to-wide`). Wide characters are cell-correct (`review-wide-characters-40x20`). Esc, Ctrl-C and cancel-from-review each return `Cancelled`.
Disabled rows (`device-off`, `both-off`) pass at all sizes. At 40x20 the widest row is 39 columns.

**findings (material)**
1. The result screen truncates the failure cause instead of wrapping it, though most of the screen is empty.
   - At 80x24 `apply-failure` cuts the line to "…changed while setup was wo…". At 40x20 the reason is gone, leaving "! t3 settings: /home/user/.t3/userdata/…".
   - The headline is cut to "…the lines…" (`apply-failure-40x20`), and `apply-success-40x20` drops the "added …" and "already set" outcomes.
   - Why material: the user cannot read what failed or what was written, and the skill says an error must state what happened.
2. `pty-ascii-80x24` (real renderer, LANG=C) still emits `·`, `↑/↓` and `❯`. The harness capture `ascii-locale-80x24` shows ASCII.
   - `theme.ts:53` honours LC_ALL, then LC_CTYPE, then LANG. The most likely cause is an inherited UTF-8 LC_ALL in the pty run, but the capture records no env, so I cannot confirm it.
   - Why material: the ASCII-locale guarantee is unproven on the real renderer. Worker.operations should rerun it with LC_ALL and LC_CTYPE unset.
3. `review-40x20` (and `review-dry-run-40x20`, `resize-to-narrow-review`) shows "… 2 more", which hides "Branch naming" and "Storage cleanup". The "=" and "~" status of those rows is the one thing they report.
   - At 80x24 and 120x40 the details are also cut mid-key with `…` (`review-80x24` rows 08–09, 13–15, 17).
   - Why material: the Intent says every always-applied key is listed on the review screen, and there is no way to scroll or expand.
4. `focus-device-40x20` breaks the Xcode path mid-word ("…/Develo" / "per)."). That makes the path unreadable.
5. `review-failed-*` and `apply-error-*` state the problem ("is not a JSON object", "the process was killed") but give no recovery step.
6. `apply-success-dry-run-80x24` and the `review-dry-run` captures keep "Setup finished." and "added …" wording on a dry run. The heading says "(DRY RUN)", but the lines read as past-tense writes.

**optional (preference)**
`pty-16` (TERM=xterm) emits 24-bit SGR (`38;2;…`), so the 16-colour tier is not honoured. The writer already noted that OpenTUI picks the tier.
The hint line omits j/k, which only the help text mentions.
The disabled and fixed value uses #737aa2 when unfocused, not the #a9b1d6 token.
#737aa2 on dark is about 4:1, below 4.5.
The `+`, `=`, `-` and `~` markers have no legend.
Esc on the review screen cancels everything, although Back exists.
There is no `?` or `q`, which the skill lists but the Intent does not.
The result hint "Enter close   Esc close" is redundant.

**not checked**
Light background and image frames are not in the captures.
Terminal restoration after exit is a behaviour check and was not run.
Result screens have no NO_COLOR or ASCII-locale capture.

**captures** (all under `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/tui-captures/`, at 80x24, 40x20 and 120x40 unless noted)

Review screen: `review`, `review-choices-off`, `review-dry-run`, `review-loading`, `review-failed`, `review-back-action`, `review-cancel-action`, `review-wide-characters`.
Cancel and apply: `cancel-escape`, `cancel-ctrl-c`, `cancel-from-review`, `applying`, `applying-interrupted`, `apply-success`, `apply-failure`, `apply-error`, `apply-success-dry-run`.
